analysis: The PR changes docs/reference/configuration.md only. Visible changes: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and a documentation expansion of the `models[].resource_policy_sha256` row (head ~line 964) describing how the cluster resource policy digest is computed, including an optional tensor-assistant suffix. The PR also touches lines ~1104 and ~1635-1636, which are outside the supplied base excerpts (units cover base lines 1-484 only). No code, defaults, environment variable semantics, trust boundaries or mitigations are changed. I read the supplied base text for consistency with the threat model. It is consistent on the prefix cache (T-041: default-on encrypted SSD tier, `DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0` kill switch, 30-minute TTL), the App Attest worker qualification opt-ins (TB-011: exact `1`, not production-ready), endpoint resumption and logout (A-008, T-053), add-on hold (TB-012, T-059, T-060) and the sandbox CLI (TB-013, T-061). The documented env vars `DARKBLOOM_ADDON_SOCKET` and `DARKBLOOM_SANDBOX_ROOT` are noted as read by every build but not forwarded to launchd. That matches existing documented behavior and is not new in this PR. Remaining uncertainty: the cluster resource-policy digest row and the changed ranges near lines 1104 and 1635-1636 were not fully visible, so I could not check the doc claims against the code. Since this is a documentation-only change, I identify no security regression.
